scope: 480 px; 15 existing checkpoints; main OpenVINO FP32 and native A/E controls
selection: Maximize equal-weight six-class recall at IoU >= 0.50. Include full score ties. Break ties by fewer false-positive boxes, then higher cutoff.
budget_unit: false-positive boxes per annotated validation image
design: Post-hoc extension of a previously viewed split. Cutoff selection reads validation only.
independent_check: Exact integer ordering and scalar IoU independently agree with the archived vectorized study threshold selector for every primary cutoff.
